title: AI Hype vs. Reality: The Shift to Engineering Services #shorts
description: Enterprise AI's promise meets operational hurdles. Raw models are commoditized; real value lies in custom implementation. Companies like Starbucks are investing heavily in in-house engineering, signaling a major shift from SaaS to hands-on AI deployment. #EnterpriseAI #AIImplementation #TechReality #MachineLearning
